CASE.label: Case
CASE.description: A judicial proceeding, litigation matter, or lawsuit identified by case title/docket number.

PERSON.label: Person
PERSON.description: An individual human being relevant to the legal proceeding.

LAWYER.label: Lawyer
LAWYER.description: An attorney or legal practitioner representing a party or appearing in court.

JUDGE.label: Judge
JUDGE.description: A judicial officer who presides over court proceedings and rulings.

WITNESS.label: Witness
WITNESS.description: An individual who gives testimony or provides sworn statements under oath.

ORGANIZATION.label: Organization
ORGANIZATION.description: A generic legal or corporate entity, institution, or collective body.

COMPANY.label: Company
COMPANY.description: A commercial business organization, corporation, LLC, or partnership.

LAW_FIRM.label: Law Firm
LAW_FIRM.description: A legal practice entity comprising one or more attorneys offering legal services.

GOVERNMENT_AGENCY.label: Government Agency
GOVERNMENT_AGENCY.description: A public administrative or executive agency, board, or municipal entity.

COURT.label: Court
COURT.description: A judicial tribunal established to hear and adjudicate legal disputes.

STATUTE.label: Statute
STATUTE.description: A formal written enactment of a legislative body (e.g., U.S. Code, state statutes).

REGULATION.label: Regulation
REGULATION.description: A rule or administrative order promulgated by a regulatory agency (e.g., CFR).

LEGAL_CONCEPT.label: Legal Concept
LEGAL_CONCEPT.description: An established legal principle, doctrine, test, or standard (e.g., Strict Liability, Res Judicata).

LEGAL_ISSUE.label: Legal Issue
LEGAL_ISSUE.description: A specific legal question or disputed matter of law raised in a case.

CLAIM.label: Claim
CLAIM.description: A cause of action or legal demand asserted by a party against another.

DOCUMENT.label: Document
DOCUMENT.description: A general textual or record item relevant to the legal proceedings.

CONTRACT.label: Contract
CONTRACT.description: A legally binding agreement or instrument between two or more parties.

EVIDENCE.label: Evidence
EVIDENCE.description: Any item, record, or physical item offered to prove or disprove a fact.

EXHIBIT.label: Exhibit
EXHIBIT.description: A document or item formally marked and produced as evidence in court.

FILING.label: Filing
FILING.description: A formal written document submitted to the court (e.g., Motion, Brief, Complaint, Answer).

TESTIMONY.label: Testimony
TESTIMONY.description: Oral or written statement given under oath during deposition, hearing, or trial.

EVENT.label: Event
EVENT.description: A factual occurrence, incident, transaction, or legal occurrence relevant to the narrative.

DATE.label: Date
DATE.description: A specific calendar date or time instance referenced in the record.

DEADLINE.label: Deadline
DEADLINE.description: A fixed procedural or statutory date/time by which an action must be completed.

HEARING.label: Hearing
HEARING.description: A formal judicial proceeding before a court or tribunal (e.g., Oral Argument, Trial, Motion Hearing).

PLAINTIFF_IN.description: Indicates that an entity is a plaintiff initiating legal action in a case.

DEFENDANT_IN.description: Indicates that an entity is a defendant accused or sued in a case.

REPRESENTED_BY.description: Indicates legal representation by an attorney or law firm.

DECIDED_BY.description: Indicates judicial decision or resolution of a case, issue, or claim by a judge or court.

FILED_IN.description: Indicates submission of a filing or document to a specific court or case file.

CITES.description: Indicates legal reference or citation of an authority, statute, case, or document.

APPLIES.description: Indicates judicial application of a statute, regulation, or legal doctrine.

INTERPRETS.description: Indicates legal interpretation or construction of a statute, contract clause, or doctrine.

OVERRULES.description: Indicates higher court precedent setting aside or invalidating prior case authority.

FOLLOWS.description: Indicates judicial adherence to binding or persuasive precedent.

DISTINGUISHES.description: Indicates distinguishing facts or legal context of current matter from precedent.

SUPPORTED_BY.description: Indicates that a claim, issue, or testimony is supported by evidence, testimony, or statutory authority.

CONTRADICTED_BY.description: Indicates that a claim, assertion, or testimony is contradicted by opposing evidence or testimony.

EVIDENCED_BY.description: Indicates factual proof of an event or claim via specific exhibit or documentary evidence.

MENTIONED_IN.description: Indicates explicit textual mention of an entity inside a document, filing, or testimony.

EMPLOYED_BY.description: Indicates formal employment relationship connecting individual to entity.

OWNS.description: Indicates legal ownership, title, or controlling interest.

REPRESENTS.description: Indicates attorney or law firm representation of a party or matter.

OCCURRED_ON.description: Associates an event, hearing, or filing with a specific calendar date entity.

OCCURRED_IN.description: Associates an event, hearing, or document with a case or court proceeding context.

BEFORE.description: Temporal ordering indicating source event/date occurred prior to target event/date.

AFTER.description: Temporal ordering indicating source event/date occurred after target event/date.

HAS_DEADLINE.description: Associates a procedural filing, case, or task with a specific deadline entity or date.
